share.title: Share: links and files
share.intro: Shorten long links and share files through the Meshloom share service. It is optional and stays off until you turn it on: while it is off, this Meshloom never contacts the service. Your browser never contacts it either; everything goes through this server.
share.enable: Turn on link and file sharing
share.unreachable: The share service is not answering right now, so its terms cannot be read and sharing cannot be turned on. Try again later.
share.enableHelp: Turning it on asks you to read and accept the terms.

status.identityPending: not yet (created the first time you share)
status.dm: Encrypted files for direct messages available
status.dmUnavailable: Encrypted files for direct messages need the radio's key, which is read once the radio is connected. Until then only those files are unavailable; links and public files still work with this instance's own sharing identity. See <security>how keys are used</security>.

consent.title: Turn on link and file sharing?
consent.intro: Sharing uses an external service. Here is exactly what leaves this Meshloom once you turn it on.
consent.sendingContent: The file or the URL you share.
consent.sendingKey: This instance's sharing public key (a pseudonym; it is not your radio's key).
consent.sendingIp: This Meshloom's IP address, which the service sees on every request.
consent.readingId: The id of each shared object you choose to display.
consent.who: Who: the service is published by the owner of Meshloom, in their own name, operating as TwinRocket, and runs on Cloudflare.
consent.retention: How long: files are kept 30 days, shortened links 365 days.
consent.docs: More in the <terms>terms</terms>, the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the <security>security documentation</security>.
consent.accept: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> (no forbidden content, takedown on report, bans for abuse) and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

shorten.legend: Shorten links when you write a message
shorten.alwaysHelp: Every link you send is shortened.
shorten.neverHelp: Links are sent as you typed them.

preview.legend: Previews of shared images and links
preview.privateHelp: Not fetched in public channels, where anyone can post a link.
preview.neverHelp: Nothing is fetched; open an item yourself to see it.
